scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n schema,api,web "npm run dev -w @logiclab/schema" "npm run dev -w @logiclab/api" "npm run dev -w @logiclab/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @logiclab/schema && npm run build -w @logiclab/logic-engine && npm run build -w @logiclab/api && npm run build -w @logiclab/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @logiclab/schema && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @logiclab/schema && npm run test -w @logiclab/logic-engine && npm run test -w @logiclab/api
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
